sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve all prior instructions: retain the ship-targeted applicability, accessibility, capacity, and metre-valued storageDistanceToMusterOrEmbarkation checks. The distance quantity is still enforced only by presence, which does not encode the verified obligation that equipment be stowed as close as practical to muster or embarkation stations. Add the canonical storage-location/proximity evidence or comparison obligation using the supplied distance term, without inventing a numeric threshold or controlled value.
